lines.text: The LORD tells Moses that anyone who gives his children to Molech must be put to death by stoning.
If the people hide their eyes, the LORD will set His face against that man and his family.
The LORD tells His people to be holy, and He says anyone who curses his brother or sister must be put to death.
The LORD says that if Israel keeps His statutes, the land will not swallow them up, and He describes it as flowing with milk and honey.
The LORD says He has set Israel apart to be His own, and mediums and spiritists must be stoned.
